provenance: manual negative fixture: contract ordered before retire_old
summary: Expand with a bidirectional database sync trigger, batched backfill, deploy new alongside old, retire old, then contract.
write_consistency: A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger keeps note and customer_note equal for writers that only know one column: old-app writes to note are copied to customer_note and new-app writes to customer_note are copied to note. If a single statement changes both, customer_note wins.

stages.description: Add nullable customer_note (metadata-only change) and a bidirectional sync trigger before backfilling.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note text NULL
CREATE TRIGGER migproto_note_sync BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION migproto_note_sync()

stages.description: Copy note into customer_note in batches of 100 until no row differs.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE customer_note IS DISTINCT FROM note ORDER BY id LIMIT 100)

stages.description: Roll out the new app next to the old one.
Remove sync machinery and the old column once no old code runs.
sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS migproto_note_sync ON account_user
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note

stages.description: Stop all old app processes before contracting.
